_method: commons/testing/capture_dressing_room.gd via DressingRoomBuilder, each artifact captured at wait=0.7s and wait=2.1s so a size-changing body is detected rather than assumed. One Godot instance at a time. Source then read back per artifact to decide whether the measurement describes the artifact or the rig.
_why_trust_field: artifact_sizes.json holds 1934 entries: 223 measure as zero, 125 exceed 20 m, 845 were never measured, and nothing in it distinguishes a real 50 m artifact from a 50 m measurement error. laser_measure has stood in it at 50.13 m since 2026-04-29 and is a hand tool. A number without a trust verdict is not usable by an editor, because the person editing cannot tell which kind they are looking at.

_trust_values.inflated_by_outlier: one piece of geometry (a label, a hidden mesh, a top-level node, a tick array) dominates the box
_trust_values.fallback_no_meshes: no geometry survived the capture filters; the [1,1,1] is a fallback, not a measurement
_trust_values.undercounts_nonmesh: real geometry exists that the capture did not count

_known_instrument_faults: capture_dressing_room.gd:427 — the 18 m size guard is PER-MESH, so a long extent made of small pieces passes and a single long mesh is deleted
capture_dressing_room.gd:420 — admits any GeometryInstance3D, so billboarded Label3D text counts as body, and `visible` is never checked
capture_dressing_room.gd:423 — GPUParticles3D returns a zero-size AABB and is dropped
capture_dressing_room.gd:424 — transforms the AABB box, so a yawed artifact gains up to sqrt(2) of phantom XZ
the harness never reads registry dna.fixture, which already exists to pin captures like laser_measure's max_range 0.25

catalyst_target.trust_reason: Default shape builds a 0.4 m outer torus (outer_radius 0.2, catalyst_target.gd:534) that yaws, and 0.4 * sqrt(2) = 0.566 is exactly the measured width, so the number is a valid (loose) spinning bound, not an error.
catalyst_target.motion_source: catalyst_target.gd:199 spins the outer torus about Y at 0.8 rad/s and :201 spins the inner torus about X at 1.2 rad/s; the body itself does not translate at defaults (_moving/_orbit are false until a map sets them at :1028-1034).
catalyst_target.note: Solid geometry is a 0.4 m torus plus a 0.24 m sphere; even the inflated 0.566 m sweep fits one cell. WARNING for the placer: if a map token sets moving or orbit (catalyst_target.gd:1028-1034) the default _patrol_range 2.5 makes it sweep 5.6 m along X (moving) or a 5.6 m circle (orbit) — that placement needs [6,1] or [6,6], and no map has ever been checked against it.

magnetic_simulation.trust_reason: The artifact's largest spatial commitment is a collision-only StaticBody3D floor, BoxShape3D 6 x 0.2 x 6 at magnetic_simulation_main.gd:21 under a node scale of 0.8 (:12) = 4.8 m square, which has no mesh at all and so is invisible to the AABB walk.
magnetic_simulation.motion_source: Four RigidBody3D magnets are pushed by apply_central_force in _physics_process (magnetic_simulation_main.gd:104-122); they translate freely on all three axes with linear_damp 0.5 and nothing containing them, which is why x grew 2.287 -> 2.333 between the two samples.
magnetic_simulation.note: 5 x 5 is the collision floor (4.8 m), not the visible mesh (2.3 x 1.9). The magnets start at (+/-1, 1, +/-1) x 0.8 with 0.2 m radius cylinders = a 1.92 m visible cluster; same-polarity pairs repel with an unbounded 1/r^2 force, so nothing guarantees they stay on the pad — two samples 1.4 s apart show it still spreading.

queer_cylinder_target.trust_reason: The mesh is a 1.2 m disc (target_radius 0.6, queer_cylinder_target.gd:73) but queer_cylinder_target.tscn's CapsuleShape3D is radius 0.3 height 1.8 rotated -90 deg about Z, so the SOLID body lies 1.8 m along local X — 50 percent wider than anything the AABB saw.
queer_cylinder_target.motion_source: queer_cylinder_target.gd:130-137 scales every ring in local X/Z by 1 + sin(t * 2.0) * 0.02; the rings are rotated 90 deg about X at :325 so this reads as a +/-2 percent breathe of the disc's world X and Y diameter. Nothing translates.
queer_cylinder_target.note: Careful with axes: measured_wdh puts 0.107 in the DEPTH slot — this is a vertical disc 1.2 m across and 0.107 m thick, standing in the XY plane, not a flat pad. Footprint [2,1] is driven by the 1.8 m capsule collider; the visual alone would be [2,1] as well only because 1.2 m crosses a cell boundary. Default face is bullseye and flag is progress; face:column restacks the same disks horizontally and would change the footprint to roughly [2,2] with a 0.8 m height.

foucault_pendulum.trust_reason: 7.6 m is exactly the podium's lower base, lower_size = canvas_size + 1.6 with canvas_size 6.0 (foucault_pendulum.gd:255 and :70) — the footprint is a hard-coded static slab, not an accident of framing.
foucault_pendulum.motion_source: The bob does swing — _physics_process at foucault_pendulum.gd:613 integrates theta from initial_amplitude 0.4 rad on an 8 m wire, an excursion of 8*sin(0.4) = 3.1 m — but that is entirely inside the 7.6 m podium, so the merged AABB is byte-identical at 0.7 s and 2.1 s. moving:false is a fact about the AABB, not about the artifact.

The 40x40 m create_ultra_vivid_floor at kusama.gd:1087 is defined but never called from generate_ultra_vivid_sculpture, so it is not in the number (and would have been discarded anyway: its 56.6 m XZ diagonal exceeds the 18 m cut at capture_dressing_room.gd:427). vertical_offset 2.0 (:25) lifts the whole sculpture at _ready; the harness re-seats it. include_tendrils is true in the .tscn — with it false the sculpture collapses to roughly [4,4].

structure_growth.trust_reason: 7.185 m is derived exactly: cells are placed at t.origin = Vector3(x,y,z) * cell_size (CellularAutomata3D_Flexible.gd:438) over x in 1..48 with cell_size 0.15 and a 0.135 box, giving 47*0.15 + 0.135 = 7.185 — the measurement reproduces the arithmetic to the millimetre, and this is the grid's hard ceiling.
structure_growth.motion_source: The automaton steps every generation_interval 0.1 s for max_generations 20 and _update_visuals rebuilds the visible shell each step, so the live extent changes shape between samples (x went 7.185 -> 6.135, y 6.435 -> 7.185); nothing translates and the volume can never exceed the 50^3 grid.
structure_growth.note: CRITICAL for the placer: the footing declares anchor [1,1] at the centre of a 3x3 pad, but the geometry is CORNER-ORIGIN — measured centre is (3.675, 3.218, 3.675), so the whole 7.2 m body occupies the +X/+Z quadrant from its anchor. A placer that centres it on the anchor buries half of it. Also randomize_on_start is true with growth_seed -1 in StructureGrowth.tscn, so the organism is different every boot; only the bounding volume is stable. This is also proof the harness DOES count MultiMeshInstance3D — it is the artifact's only geometry node.

particle_chaos.trust_reason: The only GeometryInstance3D in the subtree is one GPUParticles3D (particle_chaos.gd:80, added at :149); Godot returns a zero-size AABB for GPUParticles3D, so it is skipped by the size test at capture_dressing_room.gd:423 and the fallback at :434 fires.
particle_chaos.motion_source: Continuous isotropic emission: direction (0,0,0) with spread 180 deg, initial velocity 0.5-2.0 m/s, gravity zero, no damping, lifetime 3.0 s (particle_chaos.gd:94-105). The cloud is in permanent motion; the data's moving:false is the identical fallback repeating, not stillness.
particle_chaos.note: 13 m = 2 * (emission_radius 0.5 + 2.0 m/s * 3.0 s lifetime) — derived from source, NOT measured. Nothing fades: there is no scale_curve and no color_ramp, so particles are fully opaque at the shell and the outer envelope is genuinely visible. The dense core (mean 1.25 m/s over mean age 1.5 s) is about 5x5. This is the ONE artifact in the batch whose true claim exceeds even a doubled placeholder. Posture is float with artifact_offset y 1.5. Note also that the [1,1,1] here is NOT the 18 m discard at :427 — see batch_findings.

chaos_particles.trust_reason: Same path as particle_chaos: the only GeometryInstance3D is one GPUParticles3D (chaos_particles.gd:44, added at :113), its AABB is zero-size, it is skipped at capture_dressing_room.gd:423, and the [1,1,1] at :434 is returned.
chaos_particles.motion_source: Explosive isotropic emission, spread 180 deg, initial velocity 1.0-3.0 m/s, damping 0.5-2.0, gravity +0.5 y, lifetime 2.0 s, explosiveness 0.3 (chaos_particles.gd:44-96). Constant motion; the reported moving:false is the repeated fallback.
chaos_particles.note: Two different answers depending on what you count. Full kinematic envelope for the least-damped particle is 2 * (0.3 + [3.0*2.0 - 0.5*2.0^2/2]) = 10.6 m, so [11,11]. But scale_curve reaches 0.0 and color_ramp reaches alpha 0.0 at end of life (chaos_particles.gd:73-88), so the outer shell is invisible; at half-life the visible cloud is about 6.1 m across. [7,7] is the VISIBLE claim and what a placer should reserve. Posture is float with artifact_offset y 1.5.

example_6_4_windmill_vr.trust_reason: Not one number in the measurement is the windmill: the pole is 0.3 m tall at radius 0.025 and the blades reach 0.175 m from the hub (example_6_4_windmill_vr.gd:149-152, 197-204) = a 0.35 m machine, while three billboarded Label3D nodes at y=0.7, y=0.55 and y=-0.7 (lines 583-597, 643-649) produce cube AABBs of their own text width - the 34-char info line at font 28 alone accounts for the 2.325 m box and the -0.7 m instructions line for the bottom of the 3.253 m span.

The harness reported moving:false with drift exactly 0.000 because the spinning 0.35 m blade disc is entirely buried inside the 2.3 m text box and cannot move the merged AABB.

(2) Three ParameterController3D sliders sit at y=-0.55 and an instructions label at y=-0.7 (lines 617-647), i.e. BELOW the artifact origin; on a floor mount they are underground. The cells it covers must stay walkable or the artifact can never fire. Because of the hidden ring the capture seated it 1.375 m into the air, so any staging screenshot shows it floating. The only dressing room in this batch that is not the bare template - 5x5 footing with a raised 3x3 centre and posture 'table' - which is wrong for a floor-standing zone whose whole point is that you step into it.

laser_turret.trust_reason: Height is exactly 1.000 m in both samples because two laser cylinders of height 1.0 sit unmoved at the origin (laser_turret.gd:151-155, 170-174); they are laser_beam.visible=false / laser_glow.visible=false (lines 149, 168) but capture_dressing_room.gd:420-427 never checks visibility. The turret itself tops out at ~0.35 m (base at 0.04, column at 0.18, head at 0.3).
laser_turret.motion_source: With no target the base yaws about Y in a sinusoidal scan, turret_base.rotation.y lerped toward atan2(dir) + sin(t*0.002)*0.5 (laser_turret.gd:579-585), and the head pitches about X toward 0.1 rad (line 586). When tracking, yaw is unbounded and pitch clamps to -PI/3..PI/4 (lines 397-402).

Because the invisible beam spans y -0.5..+0.5, the capture's seat step lifted the whole turret 0.5 m off its plinth - do not read the staging shots as the mounting height. detection_range is 30 m (line 13) and it targets the player (line 26), so it reaches far beyond any footprint.

origami_pyre_plane.trust_reason: Both samples are real ImmediateMesh geometry of the base 2.0 x 3.0 sheet (origami_pyre_plane.gd:24-25, 133-149): 2.399 x 3.599 is that sheet at scale 1.2 and 1.700 x 2.550 at scale 0.85, both inside scale_pulse_range (line 29). The measurement is honest but INCOMPLETE - the affine cycle has three 4-second phases and both samples (0.7 s and 2.1 s) landed inside phase 1, SCALE, so the rotate and translate phases were never sampled.
origami_pyre_plane.motion_source: A three-phase affine cycle, one phase per 4 s (origami_pyre_plane.gd:32, 344-391): SCALE pulses _mesh_root.scale in X and Z between 0.8 and 1.2; ROTATE sweeps _mesh_root.rotation.y by sin(t*TAU)*rotation_speed*cycle_duration = +/-1.2 rad; TRANSLATE drifts the whole node +/-0.5 m along X.
origami_pyre_plane.note: Sweep computed from source, not from the samples. The 2x3 rectangle yawing to +/-1.2 rad has a bounding extent of 2|cos|+3|sin| which peaks at 3.61 m at 56 deg (reachable), and 3.61 m in depth at 34 deg; scale-1.2 gives only 2.4 x 3.6 and the X drift only 3.0, so 3.61 x 3.61 governs -> 4x4. It is a floor-level instant-kill plate 0.074 m thick with a 2.0 x 0.3 x 3.0 kill box (lines 226-228): the cells must be walkable AND lethal, and the kill box does NOT follow the scale pulse, so at scale 1.2 the visible fire is 0.2 m wider than the damage on each side.

phase_cube.trust_reason: The subject is a 0.3 m box (phase_cube.gd:52-53) rotating on two axes, which alone bounds at 0.3*sqrt(3) = 0.52; the measured 0.655 width is the billboarded Label3D 'COMPLEX' at y=0.3 (lines 124-129) whose AABB is a cube of its text width, and both GPUParticles3D contribute nothing.
phase_cube.motion_source: cube_mesh.rotate_y(delta*rotation_speed) and rotate_x(delta*rotation_speed*0.3) run every frame (phase_cube.gd:196-197), plus a breathing scale of 1.0 +/- 0.05 in the default complex phase (lines 204-206) and a randf jitter in the gas phase (line 201).
phase_cube.note: The cube is centred on the artifact ORIGIN, not seated on it (phase_cube.gd:49-66 never offsets it), so on a real plinth the lower half sinks in; the capture only looks right because capture_dressing_room.gd:178-183 re-seats it. Give it artifact_offset.y ~ +0.26 or a hand-height mount. 64 m2 reserved for a 0.09 m2 object.

plasma_critter.trust_reason: Both samples are the bare core sphere and nothing else: core_radius 0.18 gives 0.36 m, and the pulse 0.95 + 0.1*sin (plasma_critter.gd:37, 480-482, 460) brackets it to 0.342..0.378 - the measured 0.347 and 0.374 sit inside that to the millimetre. A placer that leaves only the 0.35 m footprint clear will have players taking 5 dmg from a thing they are not touching. Reserve 1x1 of geometry but 2x2 of hazard clearance. Also note the artifact reparents its visuals onto a carried stick when touched (lines 237-260), so its footprint is not fixed at runtime.

puls_markov.trust_reason: The 8.0 m height is one mesh: the 'outer environment' sphere of radius base_radius*4 (puls_markov.gd:120-124), rendered CULL_FRONT so it is an inside-out atmosphere shell, not a body (line 131). The 1.119 m 'growth' between samples is not growth at all - rotate_y(delta*0.1) (line 172) yaws that 8 m box and Godot bounds a rotated box as 8(|cos|+|sin|), which gives 8.69 at 0.087 rad and 9.81 at 0.264 rad, matching both samples. The actual cell is the membrane sphere, radius 1.0 pulsing to 1.2 (lines 104-105, 182-183).
puls_markov.motion_source: The whole node yaws about Y at 0.1 rad/s (puls_markov.gd:172); the membrane scales 1.0..1.2 and the inner sphere 0.6..0.8 (lines 182-183, 193); information hotspots spawn on a shell at radius 1.5..2.5 and drift inward at 0.3 m/s (lines 215-221, 258-259).

The 8 m outer shell is translucent, front-culled and has no collider - it is atmosphere the player walks through, so do not reserve 8x8 for it, but do expect it to visually swallow anything placed within 4 m. SEPARATE DEFECT worth flagging: this artifact builds its own Camera3D with current=true (lines 59-62), its own WorldEnvironment with fog (65-75), its own DirectionalLight3D (78-81) and a CanvasLayer with two 2D Labels (141-152). Dropped into a map it will hijack the view and paint 'Inner Entropy' over the HUD - the demo-as-artifact UI leak pattern. Its apply_grid_config is an empty pass (line 432), so a map cannot configure it at all.

qfep_sandbox_console.trust_reason: 2.303 x 0.162 x 1.555 is the real panel: a 2.0 x 1.5 x 0.05 box plus a 2.02 x 1.52 border (qfep_sandbox_console.gd:28-29, 91, 106), with the extra width coming from ordinary non-billboarded Label3D quads - which is why the depth stayed at 0.16 m instead of being cubed like the labels in the other five artifacts here.
qfep_sandbox_console.motion_source: Only the mini orb, which wobbles by lambda*0.02 = 0.008 m in X and Z (qfep_sandbox_console.gd:516-518) - that is the entire 0.0084 z-drift the harness recorded, and it is below its own motion threshold.
qfep_sandbox_console.note: This is a WALL PANEL, not a floor object: 2.3 m wide, 0.16 m deep, 1.56 m tall, all content facing +Z, sitting on the artifact origin. Its dressing room declares posture 'floor' with a 3x3 pad, which is wrong twice over. Also its AABB centre is x=-0.141, because the lambda/phi captions are centred on x=-0.7 (lines 158, 200) - so the visual centre is 14 cm left of the anchor and a centred placement will look off. It instantiates five push_button.tscn children at z=+0.05 (lines 356-395), which are the reachable controls and must not be flush against a wall.

frame_counter_display.trust_reason: 1.0 x 0.151 x 0.297 reproduces the scene exactly: BoxMesh 1x0.2x0.1 on StartButton at y=0.3 plus the 0.6-scaled 'Frames' caption at y=0.446 (frame_counter_display.tscn:59-83), and capture_dressing_room.gd:420 measures any GeometryInstance3D so the CSG panel and both Label3D count.
frame_counter_display.motion_source: frame_counter_display.gd:90 rewrites label.text every frame (Engine.get_process_frames()), which regenerates the Label3D text mesh. The digits stay inside the 1.0 m panel so the AABB never moves; the probe's 'static' is a fact about the box, not about the artifact.
